note: Full week missed. Adapted Sat+Sun re-entry only — not catch-up. Train off the site even if Arnold is offline.

sessions.title: Hinge + Upper Balance
sessions.goal: Clean re-entry after a full missed week. Rebuild hinge quality, balanced upper work, bilateral squat. Protect knee and back.
sessions.success: Leave better than you arrived. Technique crisp. Knee quiet. No hero sets after time off.
sessions.note: Missed Wed–Fri entirely. This is adapted Day A, not a cram of the week. Loads conservative vs last hard week. No BSS. Default C1 = goblet squat. Reverse lunge only if knee fully quiet through warm-up. Conditioning stays short (15/45).

items.name: Bodyweight Squats
items.focus: Check knee — must be quiet before loading.

blocks.title: Skill — Trap Bar Technique
blocks.note: Technique + feel after time off. Do not rush into working weight.

items.name: Trap Bar build-up
items.detail: 20 kg × 5, 40 kg × 5, then one set ~50–55 kg × 3–5 if crisp
items.focus: Brace. Push floor away. Glutes finish. Control lower. Stop if brace softens.

exercises.name: Trap Bar Deadlift
exercises.prescription: 55–65 kg (start lower end after week off)
exercises.focus: Every rep identical. Leave 2–3 reps in the tank. Quality > load today.

exercises.name: Half-Kneeling Cable Chop
exercises.focus: Slow. Resist rotation. Tall posture. Ribs quiet.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Bench Press
exercises.focus: Full control. Soft landing at bottom.

exercises.name: Chest Supported Dumbbell Row
exercises.focus: Pause at top. No torso yank.

blocks.title: Strength — C
blocks.note: No BSS. Knee history from Aug 8 under-kneecap pinch. Goblet is default.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
exercises.focus: Controlled. Knees track toes. Stop if any under-kneecap pinch.
exercises.note: Stay goblet. Do not progress to reverse lunge unless knee is fully quiet and goblet feels trivial.

exercises.name: Farmer Carry
exercises.focus: Walk tall. Soft ribs. Even steps.

blocks.title: Conditioning
blocks.note: Capacity rebuild — short hard efforts only.

items.name: Bike
items.focus: Consistent output. Stop at 6 if gassed. No hero intervals after a week off.

blocks.title: MoveU Cool-down — Lordosis L2 (hold 2–3 weeks)
blocks.note: L2 W3 still current. No added weight. Log reps/time quality. Alignment layer after main session.

exercises.name: Deep Tissue: All Hip
exercises.focus: Slow pressure. Breathe. Don't force into pain.
exercises.note: Optional if time is tight — rotations + stretch are the priority.

exercises.name: Side Lying Hip Lift Rotations
exercises.focus: Controlled rotation. Pelvis stacked. No lumbar flop.

exercises.name: Kickback Rotations
exercises.focus: Glute drives the kickback. Ribs quiet. Smooth rotation.

exercises.name: Double Leg Hip Rotations
exercises.focus: Low back stays calm. Move from hips, not spine.

exercises.name: TFL / Glute Med Stretch
exercises.focus: Breathe into the outside hip. No forcing.

questions: Any knee sensation during or after — even mild?
How did the back feel under trap bar after a week off?
Energy after — more drained than expected, about right, or still had room?

sessions.title: Pull + Posterior Chain
sessions.goal: Second re-entry day. Pull strength, hinge pattern variation, knee-friendly single-leg option, core anti-rotation. Complement Saturday — do not stack fatigue.
sessions.success: Pull quality solid. Posterior chain worked without beating up the back. Knee quiet. Ready for a normal Wed start next week.
sessions.note: Assumes Saturday completed. If Sat was skipped or cut short, still run this as written but drop conditioning and keep loads at the easy end. No BSS. Prefer reverse lunge only if knee was fully quiet Sat; otherwise step-up or goblet again.

items.name: Bodyweight Reverse Lunge check
items.focus: Knee must stay quiet. If any pinch, skip loaded single-leg later and use goblet or step-up.

items.name: Dead hang practice
items.focus: Active shoulders optional. Stop before grip fails ugly.

items.name: Pull-up prep
items.detail: 2 × 3–5 scap pull-ups or slow negatives if full pull-up not ready
items.focus: Assess honestly — log what you can do cleanly in Strength A.

exercises.name: Pull-up or Assisted Pull-up
exercises.prescription: BW, band-assist, or foot-assist as needed
exercises.focus: Full hang to chin clear. No kipping. Stop before form breaks.
exercises.note: Assessment day. Note assist method in exercise notes. Lat pulldown 3×8 @ moderate only if no pull-up setup available.

exercises.name: Half-Kneeling Cable Press
exercises.focus: Tall posture. No lower-back arch. Press straight, return slow.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
exercises.focus: Soft knees. Hips back. Flat back. Feel hamstrings/glutes — not lumbar grind.
exercises.note: Sat was trap bar. Keep these moderate. Do not chase load.

exercises.name: Cable Pallof Press
exercises.focus: Resist rotation. Exhale on press. Ribs stacked over pelvis.

blocks.title: Strength — C
blocks.note: Knee-first decision. Default = reverse lunge only if warm-up check was clean. Else goblet squat or box/step-up.

exercises.name: Reverse Lunge or Goblet Squat
exercises.prescription: Bodyweight–light DBs for lunge; 16–24 kg goblet if swapping
exercises.focus: Front shin vertical on lunge. No forward knee dive. Stop at first under-kneecap pinch.
exercises.note: Name which variation you used in notes. Prefer reverse lunge if Sat knee was quiet; otherwise goblet again is correct, not weak.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Farmer Carry
exercises.focus: Stay tall. Don't lean away from the weight. Even steps.

blocks.title: Conditioning
blocks.note: Optional if Saturday already taxed you. Prefer finishing strong over forcing intervals.

items.name: Bike
items.focus: Easy capacity touch. Skip entirely if energy <3/5 or back feels cooked — MoveU still happens.

blocks.title: MoveU Cool-down — Lordosis L2 (hold 2–3 weeks)
blocks.note: Same L2 W3 block. Consistency > novelty. No weight.

exercises.name: Deep Tissue: All Hip
exercises.focus: Slow pressure. Breathe. Don't force into pain.

exercises.name: Side Lying Hip Lift Rotations
exercises.focus: Controlled rotation. Pelvis stacked. No lumbar flop.

exercises.name: Kickback Rotations
exercises.focus: Glute drives the kickback. Ribs quiet. Smooth rotation.

exercises.name: Double Leg Hip Rotations
exercises.focus: Low back stays calm. Move from hips, not spine.

exercises.name: TFL / Glute Med Stretch
exercises.focus: Breathe into the outside hip. No forcing.

questions: Knee during reverse lunge / squat variation — any sensation?
Pull-ups — what did you use (BW / band / assist) and best clean set?
Back later today vs after Saturday — better, same, or tighter?
